probe_meta.label: dense-G (controlled retrieval-mechanism swap of Probe G)

response_text:
1. (Currently amended) A __computer-implemented__ method for __processing experimentally-determined ophthalmic data for__ a medical patient, comprising: storing, in a non-transitory computer readable medium, a receiver operating characteristic analysis of historical data for a region of interest on each of a plurality of different subjects; __receiving, by a processor, experimentally-determined data comprising ophthalmic measurement data for corresponding spatial locations in the region of interest of the medical patient;__ performing, by the processor, a comparison of the experimentally-determined data __at the corresponding spatial locations__ to the receiver operating characteristic analysis of the historical data; identifying, by the processor, the experimentally-determined data __at one or more of the corresponding spatial locations__ to be utilized to reach an at least preliminary conclusion regarding the medical patient based on the experimentally-determined data; and presenting, on a display device, a visible display graphically depicting a result of the comparison __for the corresponding spatial locations in the region of interest__.

13. (Currently amended) A __computer-implemented__ method for __processing experimentally-determined ophthalmic data for__ a medical patient, comprising: accessing, by a processor, a receiver operating characteristic analysis of historical data for the region of interest on each of a plurality of different subjects; identifying, by the processor, a subset of spatial locations in the region of interest where the experimentally-determined data is an accurate predictor of the medical condition to be utilized to reach an at least preliminary conclusion regarding the medical patient based on the receiver operating characteristic analysis of the historical data; __receiving, by the processor, experimentally-determined ophthalmic measurement data of the medical patient for the subset of spatial locations in the region of interest;__ comparing, by the processor, the experimentally-determined data at the subset of spatial locations of the medical patient to the receiver operating characteristic analysis of the historical data; and graphically expressing, on a display device, a result of said comparing __for the subset of spatial locations in the region of interest__.
